Hi Eliza / Oceanic procurement team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding packet. To move PO OH-053 into active status we need a couple of items to satisfy tax identity checks for a foreign entity W-8BEN-E:

1) A final, signed W-8BEN-E (PDF) — signature page must clearly show the signer's name and title.
2) Evidence of the signer's authority if the signatory is delegated (e.g., corporate resolution, board minute, or a signed delegation letter from the CFO).
3) Proof of tax ID: either the US EIN confirmation (if you have one) or your foreign tax identification number (FTIN) plus an accompanying bank letter that ties entity name to banking details.

Alternatives we can accept: a certified bank letter on bank letterhead that lists the legal entity name and account confirmation, or a notarized delegation + government ID. DocuSign with a complete audit trail is fine as long as the signer field matches the printed name on the W-8BEN-E and the envelope/audit id is provided.

For clarity, the PO will remain "pending" until we receive the required evidence. If you can send the signed W-8BEN-E and either the certified bank letter or the delegation evidence by end of week, we can issue the PO the following week.

Attachments: sample_w8bene_fillable.pdf (example), onboarding-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
